mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a pleasant 63 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park. We are currently under a waxing gibbous moon, and the ISS will be soaring over our area starting at 5:49 PM tonight, moving from the northwest over Verona High School toward the northeast near Home Depot.

The city is planning for the future with a new public works facility designed to increase efficiency and handle growth, and please remember that city offices will be closed for the holiday on November 26 and 27.
There is plenty to do this weekend with live music at Bailey's Run today and at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by yoga classes on November 23.
In a report from November 9, a driver was stopped on U S H 18/151 for unsafe operation and was arrested for a third offence O W I.
It is a great day to visit Culver's for the Crazy for Cookie Dough flavor of the day. They are open and serving until 10:30 PM tonight.
